plan.source: Ree-An-Wo (King of the Murkmire): its low cypress platform group on the south-west shore of the pool, four small decks with their ramps and planks over the water's edge, taken alone (draft wholesale --take 560) and set on our creek's north bank as the weir camp and its landing; the rest of the camp is Karsh-Naal Camp's and is not laid. The owner's rulings: main quest places get their closest match (2026-11-19); Reed-Sill and Karsh-Naal share Ree-An-Wo, each its own (2026-11-21).

differs.takes: Only the low cypress platform group at the south-west shore of Ree-An-Wo's pool (four small decks, their ramps and planks, within 560 units of its middle), where Karsh-Naal carries the whole camp round the pool.
differs.turn_and_approach: Turned 45 degrees, not 90, so the decks' water side faces our creek to the south; the player comes down the open mud bank from the north and sees the tents with the weir and the water beyond them.
differs.landmark: A woven fish weir across the head of the creek with a log walk along its top and grey moss on its fences: water and a crossing, where Karsh-Naal's landmark is its two stilt watch towers and longhouse.
differs.prunes: Both stilt watch towers, the ramp that climbed to them, the Xanmeer floor and busts, the fire camp's ground tents, the gas traps, the loot chest and the source's marsh trees and rocks round the pool are not laid.
differs.adds: The weir with its log walk and posts, pale hide tents set on the low decks themselves, the cooking pot and fire set at the landing deck by the water, the weir traps, Sithis' beard moss on the fences and the thief's sack in the reeds.
differs.dressing_and_people: Our own open riverbank plants instead of the source's cypress canopy, and no bones, cage or trophies; five weir-wardens sleep in the tents on the decks, work the weir walk and the landing and cook by the water, where Karsh-Naal's guards keep towers and a fire.
